data.description: 【铃兰 · 花田铃兰】开满白色铃兰花的清幽山谷间，丽萨蹲在花丛中，小巧的鼻尖轻轻嗅着花瓣的清香，九条蓬松的尾巴在花海中如浪花般舒展。她采下一朵开得最美的铃兰花捧给你——「铃兰花的花语是‘幸福归来’。博士，愿这朵花能永远带给你好运与快乐！」
data.promptProse: Among white lily-of-the-valley blooms, Suzuran crouches in her green-and-khaki explorer outfit with her backpack behind her. She leans close to smell a flower, then offers a chosen stem toward the viewer. The medium-wide composition carries the flower beds into the quiet valley beyond her nine tails. Bright afternoon light touches the bells and golden fur, leaving small leaf shadows beneath her hands.
data.title: 铃兰 · 花田铃兰
